content: Policy-as-code pattern for dependency-audit CI gating: written policy blocks merges on reachable HIGH/CRITICAL in production deps, allows time-boxed exceptions with named owner + expiry date for anything not immediately fixable, auto-approves dev-only lows. Encode as a committed allowlist file (e.g., audit-ci supports module/advisory/path-scoped allowlist records) reviewed on a cadence (e.g., quarterly). Layer with Dependabot for automated patch PRs; npm audit as first-pass gate, optionally a commercial SCA (Snyk) for exploitable-path/reachability analysis to reduce false-positive noise.
